exposure: serum b-hCG levels on the 14th day post-embryo transfer
cohort: The study participants were women undergoing cleavage embryo transfer (fresh or frozen-thawed) whose serum b-hCG levels were tested on the 14th day post-embryo transfer.
finding: Serum b-hCG levels measured on day 14 post-embryo transfer were strongly associated with reproductive outcomes, with higher b-hCG correlating to decreased biochemical pregnancy and adverse pregnancy outcomes, and increased full-term live birth rates.
